# Harcourt & Nell Harcourt

- [Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md) — Child of — [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) — son · since v5  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P4](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0004)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md) walks up the road to [Hollowmere](../codex/places.md#hollowmere) to visit Dr. and Mrs. [Carrow](../character/carrow.md), who have recently returned from a three-month trip to [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe). While waiting on the porch with sleeping children, [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) discuss local gossip, including Mrs. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) Miller's troubled marriage.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P1](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P2](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0002), [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P8](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P12](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0012)_

> Miss Winifred visits [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) to complain about a scandalous letter by [Grace Ashdown](../character/grace.md) published in the local paper by [Joe Vickers](../character/joe-vickers.md). [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) argues passionately that the town should celebrate the Ashdown family's talents and virtues rather than apologize for them, inspiring Miss Winifred to change her perspective.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XXVI. MISS WINIFRED GETS A NEW POINT OF VIEW
